mentions.name: Disclosure Labels for Generative Works
mentions.description: This site generates 'nutrition label'-style disclosure labels for generative works. It runs with no backend and stores nothing: the form is deterministic, populated on load from a data stream of bits decoded from a base-64 query parameter, and the URL's query parameter updates in real time as the form is filled, so reloading restores the form without local storage or cookies.
mentions.source_excerpt: I had a day-dream about nutrition labels for generative works, I made this site to feel it out: https://disclosure.launchbowl.com/
